scenario.description: Agent responds without empathy to health concern.
scenario.goal: Appropriate warmth when patient mentions symptoms.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I've been having chest tightness and I'm scared.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you want to schedule an appointment?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Should I go to the ER?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can schedule you for next week.
